usage: 甜椒 means bell pepper, a common vegetable.
It is usually eaten cooked or raw in salads.
甜椒 can be different colors like red, green, or yellow.
When buying, look for firm and shiny 甜椒 for freshness.
In cooking, 甜椒 adds a sweet and slightly crunchy texture.
